summary: China's GDP was 19,498,039,388,042.6 USD in 2025, up from 11,456,024,084,962 USD in 2016, with GDP per capita rising from 8,254.8686 USD to 13,861.9702 USD over the same period. Inflation was 0.0596% in 2025, down from 2.0% in 2016 and having peaked at 2.8992% in 2019. The 10-year bond yield is null (unavailable), while the FX rate was 0.149312 USD per CNY on 2026-09-11, a 0.196% change, versus 0.150272 USD per CNY in 2020.
